scope: continuous multi-objective minimization; catalogued families are not necessarily implemented

suites.name: ZDT
suites.reference: Zitzler, Deb and Thiele (2000). Comparison of multiobjective evolutionary algorithms: Empirical results. DOI: 10.1162/106365600568202.
suites.notes: Real-valued ZDT1/2/3/4/6 only. Binary ZDT5 is excluded. Fractional powers require care at the decision-box boundary.

suites.name: DTLZ
suites.reference: Deb, Thiele, Laumanns and Zitzler (2002/2005). Scalable multiobjective optimization test problems; expanded chapter DOI: 10.1007/1-84628-137-7_6.
suites.notes: DTLZ1-7 only. DTLZ8 and DTLZ9 have explicit constraints and must not be added to this unconstrained branch.

suites.name: SCH
suites.reference: Schaffer (1985). Multiple objective optimization with vector evaluated genetic algorithms.
suites.notes: Schaffer N.1; this repository fixes the conventional [-1000, 1000] box. Other libraries sometimes use [-10, 10].

suites.name: FON
suites.reference: Fonseca and Fleming (1993). Genetic algorithms for multiobjective optimization: Formulation, discussion and generalization.
suites.notes: Scalable Fonseca-Fleming variant with 3 variables by default (called Fonseca2 in MOEA Framework).

suites.name: POL
suites.reference: Poloni et al. benchmark; formula cross-check: MOEA Framework Poloni. Original publication details remain to be completed.
suites.notes: Both objectives use their positive minimization form. MOEA Framework represents the equivalent problem with negated objectives and maximization.

suites.name: WFG
suites.reference: Huband et al. (2006). A review of multiobjective test problems and a scalable test problem toolkit.
suites.notes: Scalable objectives; k divisible by M-1, n_var>k, even distance count for WFG2/3. Defaults M=3, k=4, n_var=24. No analytical front sampler yet.

suites.name: IDTLZ
suites.reference: Jain and Deb (2014). NSGA-III, Part II: Handling constraints and extending to an adaptive approach.
suites.notes: Selected inverted DTLZ1/2 definitions; do not conflate inversion with arbitrary sign changes.

suites.name: SDTLZ
suites.reference: Deb and Jain (2014). NSGA-III, Part I: Solving problems with box constraints.
suites.notes: Selected scaled DTLZ1/2 definitions; record the scaling factor as an instance parameter.

suites.name: UF
suites.reference: Zhang et al. (2009). Multiobjective optimization test instances for the CEC 2009 special session and competition.
suites.notes: CEC 2009 UF1-10. Defaults n=30; UF1-7 have 2 objectives and n>=3, UF8-10 have 3 objectives and n>=5. UF5: N=10, epsilon=0.1; UF6: N=2, epsilon=0.1; UF9: epsilon=0.1.

suites.name: LZ09
suites.reference: Li and Zhang (2009). Multiobjective optimization problems with complicated Pareto sets, MOEA/D and NSGA-II.
suites.notes: Specify each linkage and shape setting; identifiers are LZ09_F1 through LZ09_F9.

suites.name: IMOP
suites.reference: Tian et al. (2019). Diversity assessment of multi-objective evolutionary algorithms: Performance metric and benchmark problems.
suites.notes: Irregular fronts; verify each front's dimension and disconnected regions.

suites.name: MaF
suites.reference: Cheng et al. (2017). A benchmark test suite for evolutionary many-objective optimization.
suites.notes: CEC 2017 MaF1-15; this is a broad many-objective suite, not a claim that every member has an irregular front.

suites.name: ZCAT
suites.reference: Zapotecas-Martinez et al. (2023). Challenging test problems for multi- and many-objective optimization. DOI: 10.1016/j.swevo.2023.101350.
suites.notes: Record difficulty, bias and imbalance settings for reproducibility.

suites.name: LSMOP
suites.reference: Cheng, Jin and Olhofer (2017). Test problems for large-scale multiobjective and many-objective optimization.
suites.notes: Group sizes, linkage, and subcomponent counts are part of the instance definition.

suites.name: MMF
suites.reference: Yue, Qu and Liang (2018). A multi-objective particle swarm optimizer using ring topology for solving multimodal multiobjective problems.
suites.notes: Initial target: original MMF1-8. Later CEC extensions and suffixed variants require a separate versioned member list.

suites.name: Omni-test
suites.reference: Deb and Tiwari (2008). Omni-optimizer: A generic evolutionary algorithm for single and multi-objective optimization. Variant: pymoo 0.6.2 OmniTest.
suites.notes: OmniTest convention in pymoo 0.6.2: box [0,6]^n and 3^n equivalent Pareto subsets. The front sampler returns objective points, not decision-space subsets.

suites.name: SYM-PART
suites.reference: Rudolph, Naujoks and Preuss (2007). Capabilities of EMOA to Detect and Preserve Equivalent Pareto Subsets. Simple/rotated variants: pymoo 0.6.2.
suites.notes: Simple and rotated variants only; a=1, b=c=10, box [-100,100]^2, default rotation pi/4. Nine equivalent Pareto subsets. Rotated-distorted SYM-PART is excluded.

suites.name: FDA
suites.reference: Farina, Deb and Amato (2004). Dynamic multiobjective optimization problems: Test cases, approximations, and applications.
suites.notes: Future API must accept explicit benchmark time and document severity/frequency; never use wall-clock time.

suites.name: JY
suites.reference: Jiang and Yang (2017). Evolutionary dynamic multi-objective optimization: Benchmarks and algorithm comparisons.
suites.notes: Select the original JY1-8 version; specify benchmark time and reproducible random dynamics.

suites.name: RE_continuous
suites.reference: Tanabe and Ishibuchi (2020). An easy-to-use real-world multi-objective optimization problem suite.
suites.notes: Membership is pending a variable-type audit. Exclude integer/discrete variables and document any stochastic members; do not silently relax or round variables.

suites.name: RWA
suites.reference: Zapotecas-Martinez et al. (2023). Engineering applications of multi-objective evolutionary algorithms: A test suite of box-constrained real-world problems. DOI: 10.1016/j.engappai.2023.106192.
suites.notes: Map RWA numbers to named engineering models and convert maximization objectives explicitly.

suites.name: BNH
suites.reference: Binh and Korn (1997). MOBES: A multiobjective evolution strategy for constrained optimization problems.
suites.notes: Raw constraints; pymoo divides their residuals by 25 and 7.7.

suites.name: TNK
suites.reference: Tanaka et al. (1995). GA-based decision support system for multicriteria optimization.
suites.notes: Uses atan2(x1, x2); at the infeasible origin the angle is defined as zero. Raw second constraint has half the scale of pymoo.

suites.name: OSY
suites.reference: Osyczka and Kundu (1995). A new method to solve generalized multicriteria optimization problems using the simple genetic algorithm.
suites.notes: Raw residuals, with the first objective negative. See the explicit sign and scaling cross-checks.

suites.name: SRN
suites.reference: Srinivas and Deb (1994). Multiobjective optimization using nondominated sorting in genetic algorithms.
suites.notes: Two decision variables and two raw inequality constraints.

suites.name: CTP
suites.reference: Deb et al. (2001). Constrained test problems for multi-objective evolutionary optimization.
suites.notes: Validate version-specific distance functions and rotated constraints; record constraint normalization.

suites.name: CF
suites.reference: Zhang et al. (2009). Multiobjective optimization test instances for the CEC 2009 special session and competition.
suites.notes: CEC 2009 CF1-10; do not confuse with the ZXH-CF suite.

suites.name: C-DTLZ
suites.reference: Jain and Deb (2014). NSGA-III, Part II: Handling constraints and extending to an adaptive approach.
suites.notes: Five named C1/C2/C3 variants; all default to M=3, n=M+9. Raw G<=0. Objective-dependent radii follow pymoo 0.6.2. Unconstrained DTLZ fronts are not returned as constrained fronts.

suites.name: DC-DTLZ
suites.reference: Li et al. (2019). Two-archive evolutionary algorithm for constrained multi-objective optimization.
suites.notes: Six variants; preserve decision- and objective-space constraint definitions.

suites.name: Eq-DTLZ
suites.reference: Cuate et al. (2020). Dataset on a Benchmark for Equality Constrained Multi-objective Optimization.
suites.notes: Use the original equality benchmark, including the number of equalities as a parameter.

suites.name: Eq-IDTLZ
suites.reference: Cuate et al. (2020). Dataset on a Benchmark for Equality Constrained Multi-objective Optimization.
suites.notes: The original dataset contains Eq-IDTLZ1-2; extensions 3/4 need separate provenance.

suites.name: MW
suites.reference: Ma and Wang (2019). Evolutionary constrained multiobjective optimization: Test suite construction and performance comparisons.
suites.notes: Implement and validate all shape, distance and constraint components.

suites.name: LIR-CMOP
suites.reference: Fan et al. (2019). An improved epsilon constraint-handling method in MOEA/D for CMOPs with large infeasible regions.
suites.notes: Large infeasible regions; maintain raw inequality residuals.

suites.name: DAS-CMOP
suites.reference: Fan et al. (2020). Difficulty adjustable and scalable constrained multi-objective test problem toolkit.
suites.notes: Record the diversity, feasibility and convergence difficulty triplet.

suites.name: DAS-CMaOP
suites.reference: Fan et al. (2020). Difficulty adjustable and scalable constrained multi-objective test problem toolkit.
suites.notes: Keep many-objective variants separate from DAS-CMOP; verify the paper's scalable definition.

suites.name: DOC
suites.reference: Liu and Wang (2019). Handling constrained multiobjective optimization problems with constraints in both the decision and objective spaces.
suites.notes: Constraints occur in both decision and objective spaces.

suites.name: NCTP
suites.reference: Original NCTP publication and source implementation pending.
suites.notes: Original source and exact member/version mapping still need verification before Python implementation.

suites.name: ZXH_CF
suites.reference: Zhou, Xiang and He (2021). Constrained multiobjective optimization: Test problem construction and performance evaluations.
suites.notes: Distinct from CEC 2009 CF. Keep the user's underscore spelling as the display name.

suites.name: LSCMOP
suites.reference: Qiao et al. (2024). Benchmark problems for large-scale constrained multi-objective optimization with baseline results. DOI: 10.1016/j.swevo.2024.101504.
suites.notes: The linked source uses LSCM names. Verify the LSCMOP-to-LSCM mapping and scalable group settings before listing members.

suites.name: CMMOP
suites.reference: Original suite publication and source implementation pending.
suites.notes: Verify the original CMMOP suite and distinguish it from CMMF and the generic CMMOP problem class.

suites.name: CRE
suites.reference: Tanabe and Ishibuchi (2020). An easy-to-use real-world multi-objective optimization problem suite.
suites.notes: The full CRE suite contains non-continuous designs; variable types must be audited before adding a problem to the continuous Python API.

suites.name: Welded-Beam
suites.reference: Reference implementation: pymoo welded-beam problem.
suites.notes: Two objectives and four raw constraints, matching pymoo 0.6.2. J uses sqrt(2)*h*l*(l^2/12+(h+t)^2/4), which differs from variants using twice this J. Variables (h,l,t,b) in inches. See formula constants and raw residual scaling.

suites.name: RCM_continuous
suites.reference: CEC 2021 real-world constrained multiobjective benchmark; source: PlatEMO RWMOPs.
suites.notes: Membership is pending a variable-type audit of the original CEC 2021 real-world constrained suite. Do not treat all RCM problems as continuous.
